description_en: You can invoke this API to delete a security tunnel that has been shut down.
description_zh: 已经关闭的安全隧道，可以调用该PI进行删除
kebab_example: aliyun iot delete-device-tunnel --tunnel-id d4098041-a560-000 --iot-instance-id iot-000-v6000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDeviceTunnel

parameters.description_en: The ID of the security tunnel to delete.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the security tunnel to delete
parameters.name: tunnel_id

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
